protocol.description:
Lets a client describe rounded rectangles of its toplevel surface that the compositor draws as glass: the desktop behind the window, blurred and refracted, under the client's own (translucent) pixels. Outside the shapes nothing is drawn behind the window.
The compositor decides how the glass looks (its effect preset); the client only says where it is. The shapes need a translucent surface: an opaque region hides them.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: the surface already has a glass object

request.name: get_glass
request.description: Creates the glass object of a toplevel's root surface. A surface may have one at a time.

interface.name: umbriel_glass_v1
interface.description: The shapes are double-buffered: set_shapes takes effect on the next wl_surface.commit, together with the buffer drawn for them.

entry.name: invalid_shapes
entry.summary: array size is not a whole number of shapes

entry.name: too_many_shapes
entry.summary: more shapes than the compositor accepts (16)

request.name: destroy
request.description: Removes the shapes at the next wl_surface.commit.

request.name: set_shapes
request.description: An array of shapes, each six int32 values in surface-local logical pixels: x, y, width, height, corner radius, flags (reserved, 0). Shapes should not overlap. An empty array removes the glass.
